phases.name: Recovery, collision gate and null measurement
definition_of_done: branch secured from original base before sync
both recovered JSON artifacts validate
four canonical place identities remain distinct
null measurement complete

phases.name: Canonical identity, source owner and coordinate prior-work gate
definition_of_done: canonical owner confirmed
museum, rock carvings and Ekebergsletta excluded as proxies
verified geometry preserved unless a documented regression exists

phases.name: Source/claim pack and factual research closure
definition_of_done: all publishable factual assertions have explicit evidence scope
volatile facts separated from evergreen facts
gaps are researched or explicitly blocked

phases.name: Core Place, Fagverk and structured profiles
definition_of_done: metadata remains precise
spatial, temporal, history and source profiles are place-specific
nature, history and art claims respect owner boundaries

phases.name: Description and popup editorial surfaces
definition_of_done: description protocol passes
no duplicated filler across tabs
Om, Historie, Kilder, Språk, Før/etter and Nyheter are independently approved or justified N/A

phases.name: Stories, People, Objects and relations
definition_of_done: Story governance passes
People identities are canonical and sourced
Objects belong to the correct place owner
Scream-viewpoint uncertainty is preserved

phases.name: Quiz, rounds, reading tracks, routes and Knowledge/Aha
definition_of_done: quiz is source-bound and non-generic
routes use safe official path geography
reading tracks satisfy access policy
four visible rounds are coherent and non-empty where relevant
Nature, Fagverk and Knowledge/Aha integration is verified

phases.name: Assets, visible QA, full validation and release gate
definition_of_done: JSON, schema and reference gates pass
no collision or duplicate-text regressions
visible popup and rounds inspected
no broken images or false zero states
six-part quality review has no blocker
PR is green before merge

release_sequence: sync from fresh main only after recovery files are committed
do_not_do: recreate branch from current main before recovery
replace area anchor with museum address
use generic filler to close checklist items
weaken gates to save model or API cost
